reviewed_behavior: Exact root six-file collection, full cohort and all 30 stages; all required schedule cells remain represented.
Captured JSON bytes are hashed before parsing; initial complete output trees and terminal files/entry sets are compared.
Command interpreter/allowed flags/executed evaluator and known option grammar are checked; executed alias bytes remain bound.
CLI serializes prospective output before final root/source/input/tree checks and exclusive publication.
Same-state complete scalar grids, timing/repeat parity, graph references, D3 vector benefit arithmetic and sign fractions are checked.
Failed policy/clean metrics remain null; undefined correlations and exact particle counts are retained.
Equal declared sources precede three paired seed summaries; incomplete full-H cells never become survivor means.
H200 remains a pointwise accepted-prefix metric; full H295, boundary and graph means require complete coverage.
Explicit within-arm controls, mix-minus-base effects and risk-minus-random interaction preserve all seed values.
Whole-process, publication and fixed-order policy clocks remain distinct; no speedup inferred from graph counts.
publication_scope: Use CLI for released collection/aggregation. Direct functions return candidates and do not bind a root-release file.
